name: War-Awoken Are You Serious? (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Wind/Bio/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Wind/Fire Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if target has at least 0/40% Imperil Wind/Bio
WS Blue: Imperil Wind/Bio 30% to all targets
WS Gold: DeProtect 20% to all targets
